bibl.title: The noun πῶλoς in the Greek papyri.
bibl.seg: Nikos Litinas, The noun πῶλoς in the Greek papyri.
bibl.note: The word πῶλος indicates a young animal. The expression πῶλος ἄβολος seems to indicate young donkeys. When a young camel was indicated, either πῶλος or ἄβολος was used. We surveyed all the instances of the word πῶλος as attested in the published documents so far in order to clear out the references to a certain animal.
